prompt:
Bold clean ink linework, flat vibrant cell-shaded colors, rounded expressive character designs, distinctive 1980s Akira Toriyama manga aesthetic. Create ONE finished landscape 1536x1024 comic panel, NOT a character sheet. Beijing present-day ordinary apartment, or 1967 radio station in flashbacks pages 4–6. Cel shading throughout, no watercolor.
SCENE: 방 안의 빛이 완전히 셀 채색으로 전환. 청신의 얼굴에서 젊은 예원제의 얼굴이 겹쳐 보임 — 디졸브 전환.
Visible named cast: 예원제, 청신. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. All lettering and exact digits will be added later: NO readable text, numbers, symbols, balloons, captions or watermark in generated artwork. Clean coherent anatomy, strong ink composition, no extra characters or alien creatures. Non-graphic disaster where described.
